metadata.name: [SRE] K8s container memory limit ≥ 95%
metadata.description: P2: k8s.container.memory_limit_utilization ≥ 0.95 for ≥5 samples in lookback (excludes datadog-agent-injected). Pair with restart burst for oom.likely.

breach.query:
FROM metrics-kubeletstatsreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `metrics.k8s.container.memory_limit_utilization` >= 0.95
| WHERE `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name` != "datadog-agent-injected"
| WHERE `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name` IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_util = MAX(`metrics.k8s.container.memory_limit_utilization`),
        samples = COUNT(*)
    BY `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`
| WHERE max_util >= 0.95 AND samples >= 5
| KEEP `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`,
       max_util,
       samples
